status: proposal-only; not imported by the game; no audio generated

tormentor.label: The Tormentor
tormentor.direction: Adult female, low register, dry and controlled; precise consonants, restrained contempt, never shouted.

anxious.label: The Anxious One
anxious.direction: Adult female, lighter register, breath before short phrases; contained urgency, intelligible, never shrill.

manipulator.label: The Manipulator
manipulator.direction: Adult female, soft middle register, intimate and unhurried; welcoming cadence with an unresolved ending.

protector.label: The Protector
protector.direction: Adult female, warm middle register, grounded natural speech; short complete thoughts, calm firmness.

policy.missingAssetBehavior: skip without fetching or blocking gameplay

cues.trigger: wakeUpIntro.done rising edge
cues.guard: wait 1.5 active seconds after control returns; alive; no tutorial or cinematic

lines.text: Shaun. Feel the ground. You're standing.

cues.trigger: 12 active seconds since wake cue ended
cues.guard: still no first credit; no nearby active enemy; no tutorial or cinematic

lines.text: First year. And already you're lost.

cues.trigger: firstCreditCollected followed by orbPortalCutscene completion
cues.guard: first pair remains alive and visible; wait 0.5 active seconds after control returns; cancel if obsolete

lines.text: Two of them. Shaun, they're out.

cues.trigger: credit count reaches 2
cues.guard: collection effect finished; no cinematic; player not under immediate attack

lines.text: Every credit asks for something back.

cues.trigger: credit count reaches 4
cues.guard: wait for collection effect; quiet interval

lines.text: Halfway. You earned every one.

cues.trigger: credit count reaches 6
cues.guard: quiet interval; no higher cue pending

lines.text: Still counting. Will it ever be enough?

cues.trigger: idle for 25 active seconds after at least 2 credits
cues.guard: grounded; no nearby enemy; no tutorial, inventory or cinematic; cancel on movement or danger
cues.overlap: protector enters during final 0.25 seconds of manipulator

lines.text: We could stay here. Let the year go on without us.
Rest for a breath. Then choose your next step.

cues.trigger: visible active zombie crosses within 6 world units
cues.guard: exclude reserves and portal exits; moving toward player; alive; no tutorial; expire after 1 active second

lines.text: Too close. Too close.
lines.delivery: contained urgency; not a directional instruction

cues.trigger: nonfatal health decrease
cues.guard: wait 0.7 active seconds for Shaun's hurt sound; health still above 0; no current vocal

lines.text: Breathe, Shaun. Find some space.
That hurt. Keep breathing.

cues.trigger: third nonfatal health decrease within 30 active seconds
cues.guard: health above 35; defer until combat eases; supersedes ordinary hurt cue; expire after 4 seconds
cues.overlap: protector enters during final 0.2 seconds of tormentor

lines.text: They'll mark every mistake.
A mistake isn't the whole of you.

cues.trigger: health ratio crosses below 0.4
cues.guard: nonfatal; wait for hurt vocal; supersedes other injury cues; no repeated threshold oscillation

lines.text: You're still here. One thing at a time.
lines.delivery: close and calm, leave heartbeat audible

cues.trigger: ammo crosses to zero with firearm equipped
cues.guard: not bashing, rolling or in tutorial; expire after 2 seconds; cancel if ammo restored

lines.text: Empty. Shaun, it's empty.

cues.trigger: events.deanReveal
cues.guard: supersede final-credit commentary; wait at least 0.8 seconds after reveal sound; no other internal voice

lines.text: All that work. He still holds the degree.

cues.trigger: bossCutscene completes with bossState done
cues.guard: at least 2 active seconds after camera return; remainingZombies above zero

lines.text: He leaves. You do all the work.

cues.trigger: bluePortalUnlocked rising edge
cues.guard: wait 2 active seconds after final kill; alive; no player absorption; expire on entry

lines.text: They're gone. You can move on.

cues.trigger: unlocked portal approach within 10 world units
cues.guard: grounded; outside 2.2-unit entry trigger; at least 14 seconds since last cue; cancel on entry

lines.text: Another year. Perhaps this one will be kinder.

cues.trigger: first retry after actual Level 1 death; wake intro completes
cues.guard: wait 1.5 active seconds; replaces wake cue; manual R restart does not count

lines.text: Start where you are. I'm still here.

cues.trigger: second death retry; wake intro completes
cues.guard: replaces other wake or retry cues; wait for control; never speak over death
cues.overlap: protector enters during final 0.2 seconds of tormentor

lines.text: Back at the beginning, Shaun.
And you know more than before.

cues.trigger: player_arrival finishes
cues.guard: arrival cinematic only; before blade demonstration; if line cannot finish before demonstration then skip

lines.text: I did say perhaps.

cues.trigger: deanBladeIntro becomes false
cues.guard: player still on starting safe deck; wait 1 second after score onset; cancel if crossing a saw

lines.text: His pace isn't yours. Watch the sweep.

cues.trigger: puzzleIndex changes from 0 to 1
cues.guard: grounded on safe deck; do not delay into first bridge jump

lines.text: Past them. We're past them.

cues.trigger: idle 12 active seconds at bridge checkpoint
cues.guard: grounded on fixed deck; no jump, roll or nearby enemy; cancel on leaving deck

lines.text: Even the ground won't commit to you.

cues.trigger: bridge checkpoint on first visit or death retry
cues.guard: choose instead of bridge-wait cue; fixed safe deck; no timed movement

lines.text: Let your eyes settle before your feet move.

cues.trigger: puzzleIndex changes from 1 to SPIKE_CORRIDOR_PUZZLE
cues.guard: grounded on eight-metre fixed landing; cancel on entering spikes

lines.text: Solid ground. Look ahead before you leave it.

cues.trigger: wait 10 active seconds on spike entry landing
cues.guard: still outside retracting corridor; no combat; no time-specific crossing advice

lines.text: The floor keeps moving. Even here.

cues.trigger: first ambush record becomes visible while jumping
cues.guard: live visible record only; not merely ambush.start; expire after 1 active second

lines.text: They're climbing out!

cues.trigger: currentWave advances to 2
cues.guard: only if grounded on fixed safe landing; previous wave gone; cancel if next record becomes visible; otherwise skip

lines.text: There's always another demand.

cues.trigger: nonfatal health decrease in retracting corridor
cues.guard: wait 0.7 seconds after hurt sound; player subsequently grounded on fixed landing; cancel if combat persists

lines.text: You're hurt. Give yourself a breath.

cues.trigger: health ratio crosses below 0.4 during ambush
cues.guard: alive; defer until hurt vocal ends; supersedes spike-hurt cue; never during a jump

lines.text: Stay with me, Shaun. Just this moment.

cues.trigger: ambush.cleared rising edge
cues.guard: wait 2 seconds after final kill; fixed landing; before demonstration; cancel if watch begins

lines.text: Nothing else is climbing.
You held your ground.
lines.delivery: short affirmation; sequential after anxious line

cues.trigger: idle 15 active seconds at memory entrance after ambush clear
cues.guard: phase chase; fixed landing; before demonstration; cancel on approach
cues.overlap: protector enters during final 0.25 seconds of manipulator

lines.text: You don't have to prove anything to him.
lines.delivery: plausible comfort with a pull toward withdrawal

lines.text: Then do this for yourself.

cues.trigger: ambush cleared while memoryApproachArmed false; idle 8 active seconds near entrance
cues.guard: fixed landing; phase chase; no other cue; cancel once armed or watch begins

lines.text: One step back. Meet him at the entrance.
lines.delivery: clear, gentle; never during tile traversal

cues.trigger: retry after actual memory failure
cues.guard: safe checkpoint arrival only; at most 0.6 seconds of speech; cancel before watch begins at 0.9 seconds

lines.text: Fresh eyes.

cues.trigger: phase becomes dean_exit after last valid landing
cues.guard: grounded safe checkpoint; all tile timers null; wait 1 second after landing; complete before portal passage

lines.text: And he still won't wait for you.
You remembered. That was yours.

cues.trigger: phase exit; idle 15 active seconds on safe final checkpoint
cues.guard: Dean passage finished; no voice in preceding 14 seconds; cancel on player entry

lines.text: They call it progress. It still feels like a chase.

cues.trigger: retry after actual saw or bridge death
cues.guard: fixed checkpoint; exclude memory and manual restart; one alternative only

lines.text: Still trying to keep up?
lines.delivery: quiet question; no follow-up on same retry

lines.text: You can begin again without rushing.
lines.delivery: patient, available only on fixed hazard checkpoints
